title: bank
summary: See where CWM keeps its data, or delete it.
notes: `bank info` shows the database path, the copy bank path and the file size.
`bank delete` lists what it will remove, including the number of script files. You must type `delete` to confirm.
Nothing is deleted without that confirmation.

flags.name: --copy-bank
flags.desc: Also delete the shared copy bank database file.

examples.title: Where is my data?
